title: Seoul shares plunge over 5% on AI regulation concerns after US midterms
caption:
South Korean markets saw a sharp decline following the US midterm elections. Investors are reacting to potential new regulations on AI data centers.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul shares plunge over 5% on AI regulation concerns after US midterms
